gaps.explanation: Statement p5 (Governmental Funds) prints Transfers in (out) net per fund: General (933,699), Street 933,699, Sales Tax (139,346); transfers in = Street 933,699. detail[] takes the General Fund from the Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (pp17-18), which prints the transfers gross per department: Administrative (1,756,850), Police 284,114, Summer Recreation 59,794, Park 155,495 (p17), Pool 57,536, Auditorium 69,855, Library 132,423, Zoning 63,639, Recycling 295 (p18); Total (933,699). Schedule transfers in = 823,151 (departments) + Street 933,699 = 1,756,850; gap -823,151 = the departments' transfers in (284,114+59,794+155,495+57,536+69,855+132,423+63,639+295 = 823,151), which are transfers between departments inside the General Fund and are netted in the statement's General Fund (933,699). Printed amounts on both sides; nothing missing or duplicated. (Detail index 93, Administrative (1,756,850), is labelled 'Transfers In' although negative: corrected in the 'other financing' entry below; this does not change the gap.)

Statement p5 transfers out = General 933,699 + Sales Tax 139,346 = 1,073,045. Schedule transfers out = Administrative department (1,756,850) (p17, gross) + Sales Tax (139,346) = 1,896,196; gap -823,151 = the Administrative department's transfers to the other General Fund departments (1,756,850 - 933,699 = 823,151), netted inside the General Fund on the statement.

detail[] has no business-type lines. Trimmed p7 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds) prints Electric Fund, Water Fund and Sewer Fund columns. JSON business receipts 6,607,505 = Consumer sales 6,161,417 + Other revenue 86,633 + Interest income 107,070 + Grant income 252,385. Added per fund: Electric 4,431,824 + 71,847 + 95,947 + 252,385 = 4,852,003; Water 1,140,630 + 3,218 + 7,434 = 1,151,282; Sewer 588,963 + 11,568 + 3,689 = 604,220. Sum 4,852,003 + 1,151,282 + 604,220 = 6,607,505 = statement total (gap 0).
